title: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT
(GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1948
THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (GOVERN MENT
CONTROL) ACT, 1948
ACT No. XXIV of 1948
[8th January, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
regulation of mines and oil-fields and mineral development
1. Short title extent and commencement. -(1) This Act may be called
the Regulation of Mines and Oil-fields and Mineral Development (Subs. by A.
O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal Control".) [Government Control] Act, 1948.
(Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform)
Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for the original sub-section
(2) (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).) [(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.]
(3) It shall come into force on
such date(The
1st June, 1949, see Gaz. of P., 1949, Pt. 1, p. 246.) as the Central Government may, by notification in the official
Gazette, appoint in this behalf.
(Section IA, which was ins. by the
Regulation of Mines and Oil fields Mineral Development (Federal Control)
(Amdt.) Ordinance, 195: (31 of 1955), s. 2, has since been lapsed.)* * * * * *

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948
sections.description:
Power to make rules

THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT
(GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1948
THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (GOVERN MENT
CONTROL) ACT, 1948
ACT No. XXIV of 1948
[8th January, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
regulation of mines and oil-fields and mineral development
2. Power to make rules. (The Amendment in
section 2, by Ord. 31 of 1955, s. 3, has since been lapsed.) It is hereby declared to be expedient
in the public interest that the (Subs. by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Central
Government")[appropriate
Government] shall have power to make rules(For the Pakistan Petroleum (Production) Rules, 1949, see Gaz.
of P., 1949, Ext., pp. 501-552; for the Natural Gas Rules, 1960, see ibid.,
1960 Ext., pp. 949-956; and for the Pakistan Mining Concession Rules, 1960, see
ibid., pp. 1107-1166.) to
provide for all or any of the following matters; namely :-
(1) the manner in which, and the
authority to whom, application for the grant or renewal of an ex ploration or
prospecting licence, a mining lease or other mining concession shall be made,
and the prescribing of the fees to be paid on such application;
(2) the conditions in accordance
with which the grant or renewal of an exploration or prospecting licence, a
mining lease or other mining concession may be made, and the prescribing of
forms for the execution or renewal of such licence, lease, and concession;
(3) the circumstances under which
renewal of a licence, lease or concession as aforesaid may be refused, or any
such licence, lease or concession whether granted or renewed may be revoked;
(4) the determination of the
rates at which, and the conditions subject to which, royalties, rents and taxes
shall be paid by licensees, lessees and gran tees of mining concessions;
(5) the refinement of ores and
mineral oils;
(6) the control of production,
storage and distribution of minerals and mineral oils;
(7) the fixation of the prices at
which minerals and mineral oils may be bought or sold; and
(8) any matter ancillary or
incidental to the matters set out in the foregoing clauses of this section,
and the (Subs. by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for
"Central Government".)[appropriate
Government] may, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules
accordingly.

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948
sections.description:
Penalties

THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT
(GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1948
THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (GOVERN MENT
CONTROL) ACT, 1948
ACT No. XXIV of 1948
[8th January, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
regulation of mines and oil-fields and mineral development
3. Penalties. In making any rule under the preceding section the (Subs. by A.
O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Central Government".) [appropriate Government] may direct
that any breach of that rule shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term
which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948
sections.description:
Effect of rules etc., inconsistent with other enactments

THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT
(GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1948
THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (GOVERN MENT
CONTROL) ACT, 1948
ACT No. XXIV of 1948
[8th January, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
regulation of mines and oil-fields and mineral development
4. Effect of rules etc., inconsistent with other enactments. Any
rule made under this Act, and any order made under any such rule, shall have
effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent therewith contained in any
enactment or in any instrument having effect by virtue of an enactment other
than this Act.
(Section 4A, which was ins. by the
Regulation of Mines and Oil fields Mineral Development (Federal Control)
(Amdt.) Ordinance, 1955 (31 of 1955), s. 4, has since been lapsed.)* * * * * * *

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948
sections.description:
Power to exempt

THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT
(GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1948
THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (GOVERN MENT
CONTROL) ACT, 1948
ACT No. XXIV of 1948
[8th January, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
regulation of mines and oil-fields and mineral development
5. Power to exempt.
The (Subs.
by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Central Government".) [appropriate Government] may, by
notified order, declare that any mineral or mineral oil or any class or
description thereof shall be exempt from all or any of the pro visions of the
rules made under this Act, or that such provisions shall apply thereto with
such modification or subject to such conditions as may be specified in the
order.

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development Government Control Act 1948
sections.description:
Definitions of appropriate Government

THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT
(GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1948
THE REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (GOVERN MENT
CONTROL) ACT, 1948
ACT No. XXIV of 1948
[8th January, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
regulation of mines and oil-fields and mineral development
6. Definitions of appropriate Government. (Section
6 added by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch.) [In this Act, "appropriate Government" means, in
relation to mines of nuclear substances, oil-fields and gas fields, and
development of such substances, mineral oil and gas, the Central Government
and, in relation to the other mines and mineral development, the Provincial
Government.]
